questions.question: Rajesh ranked 17th from the top and 44th from the bottom in his class. How many students are there in his class?
questions.solution:
To find the total number of students in the class, we use the formula:

Total students = (Rank from top) + (Rank from bottom) - 1

Given:

 
• Rajesh's rank from the top = 17th
 
• Rajesh's rank from the bottom = 44th</li&

Some nuts are black.

All black are crows.

All crows are pens.

Conclusions:

(I) All nuts are black.

(II) Some black are crows.

2. All black are crows.

questions.question: Shubham ranked 19th from the top and 46th from the bottom in his class. How many students are there in his class?
questions.solution:
**Given:** Shubham ranked 19th from the top and 46th from the bottom in his class.

Shubham's rank from the top = 19

Shubham's rank from the bottom = 46

Total students = Shubham's rank from the top + Shubham's rank from the bottom - 1

= 19 + 46 - 1 → 64

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some houses are small.

Some small are forks.

All forks are knives.

Conclusions:

(I) Some small are houses.

(II) Some forks are small.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5e9e992c3f36ab553a318ea70f50e03830fb2a15619866cc114e794801b5954.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some small are houses → Follow (As some houses are small. As some part of houses is common with small, therefore it is true.)

(II) Some forks are small → Follow (As some small are forks. As some part of small is common with forks, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
